responsibility: Declares gcc::context, the top-level holder for one ‘parallel universe’ of GCC global state. The class owns high-level services such as pass management and dump-file management and exposes the global singleton pointer g, allowing passes and other subsystems to access shared compiler-wide managers while keeping that state grouped in an explicit context object.
same_name_distinction: Defines the gcc::context class interface and declares the global pointer g that groups compiler-wide managers; unlike gcc/context.cc, it does not allocate, initialize, or destroy that singleton state.
